name: dijkstra
description: Dijkstra's shortest-path algorithm on a weighted adjacency list graph returning distances and predecessors from a source node.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to compute the shortest path from a single source to all other nodes in a non-negative-weight graph, such as network routing, GPS navigation, or dependency resolution.

parameters.name: graph
parameters.description: Adjacency list as {node: [{node, weight}]} mapping each node to its neighbours with edge weights.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The starting node key from which all shortest paths are computed.
